title: VentTools opening and setting-out rule schema

additionRange.description: Opening derived from nominal size plus manufacturer minimum and maximum additions.

edgeClearanceRange.description: Clearance stored independently at left, right, top and bottom. Required for non-central or asymmetric setting-out.

tableRange.description: Size-band table returns minimum and maximum openings.

selectionPolicy.manufacturerPreferred: Use only where manufacturer states a preferred value.
selectionPolicy.projectSelected: A project value inside the tested range; never label it as a manufacturer requirement.
selectionPolicy.default: Do not silently use midpoint. Where no preferred value is stated, display minimum and maximum and require a selected value for builder setting-out.

settingOutPolicy.nonCentralMethods: Builder AFFL remains locked until a bottom clearance or explicit position is selected within the documented range.
settingOutPolicy.noGuess: A total opening range must not be halved unless the controlling drawing requires a centralised damper.
